risks.risk: Shutter count may be higher than stated (affects value).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of the camera’s shutter count screen (or EXIF/metadata showing shutter count) taken in-camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used Lumix G7 with unknown shutter count (worst case: not guaranteed low).

risks.risk: Lens may have hidden fungus/haze/fine scratches not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of lens front and rear elements in bright light (and ideally a short video showing focus with lens cap off).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens condition not guaranteed (worst case: possible issues).

risks.risk: Batteries/charger may be non-original or lower-capacity (affects usability/resale).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of battery and charger labels/part numbers; ideally a short clip showing charging indicator working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed original (worst case: generic/unknown quality).

risks.risk: Camera may have functional faults not shown in static photos (buttons, AF, IBIS, sensor dust).
risks.proof: Short test video: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a subject, and one sample photo to check for sensor dust.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed fully functional (worst case: may need servicing).

proof_requests: Send a screenshot/photo of the shutter count from the camera (or EXIF/metadata showing shutter count).
Send close-up, well-lit photos of the lens front and rear glass to confirm no fungus/scratches.
Send close-up photos of battery and charger labels/part numbers; include a short clip showing the charger charging.
Send a short functionality test video (AF works, buttons responsive) and one sample image to check sensor/lens clarity.
response.reason: Even though the seller claims they tested it, the key value drivers (shutter count, lens condition, originality/repair status, and full functionality) are not verifiable from the existing photos. Without new proof, pricing would be guesswork.
